fields.acceptance: A Go test in cmd/rhiza (go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScriptShard) asserts that for n=4 the four shards are disjoint, together cover every script in testdata/script, and are round-robin over the sorted names; that unset selects all scripts; and that a malformed value (0/4, 5/4, x) fails with a clear error.
fields.statement: TestScripts runs one shard of cmd/rhiza's scripts when RHIZA_TEST_SHARD=i/n is set (1-based): the sorted testdata/script/*.txtar names whose index mod n is i-1, passed as testscript Files; unset, it runs every script as before.

fields.acceptance: A Go test beside TestMakeTestTimeout in cmd/rhiza/makeupdate_test.go (go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestMake') runs make -n on each new target and asserts its go test line carries -trimpath and the budget skip or run regex, that test-api's shards for n=2 partition internal/api's listed tests with no budget test among them, and that test-budgets prints the timings; TestMakeTestTimeout still passes unchanged for make test.
fields.statement: The Makefile has one target per CI job: test-scripts SHARD=i/n (cmd/rhiza's scripts, budgets skipped), test-api SHARD=i/n (internal/api's top-level tests from go test -list, budgets excluded, split round-robin into an anchored -run regex), test-rest (every other package, budgets skipped), test-budgets (the timing budgets alone, -count=1 -p 1, printing the read-budget timings) and lint (fmt-check, vet, self-check); make test and make check still run the full suite.

fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/ciworkflow (go test -trimpath ./internal/ciworkflow/...) parses .github/workflows/ci.yml and asserts the jobs and matrices above, strategy.fail-fast false on each matrix, setup-go with cache on and cache-dependency-path go.sum in every job, each job's run step calling make, and a job named check with needs on every other job, if: always() and a step failing unless every needed result is success; the existing ci-yml triggers and concurrency checks still pass. The change set's own PR CI run completes in about 5 minutes or less, read from gh run view.
fields.statement: CI runs the suite as parallel jobs of one workflow: lint, a matrix of 4 script shards, a matrix of 2 internal/api shards, rest and budgets, each calling its make target with fail-fast off and actions/setup-go caching modules and the build cache keyed on go.sum, and an aggregate job named check that needs every other job, runs if: always() and fails unless each succeeded; a PR's CI gives its verdict in about 5 minutes.

fields.acceptance: Unit tests in internal/api (go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestParsePRView|TestChecksVerdict') feed a statusCheckRollup of the lint, shard, rest, budgets and check jobs of one run with one failed script shard and a cancelled or failed aggregate, and assert the verdict is settled and not green, failed names that shard and the aggregate, and every check carries the same RunID; a rollup where all jobs succeeded is green; one still in progress is not settled.
fields.statement: ship check gives one verdict over a PR whose CI is several jobs of one run: green only when every job and the aggregate check completed and passed, and a failed shard is named with the run ID its log is read from.
